experiment: detector distillation: DeepLabV3+/EfficientNet-B0 student from the deployed B4 teacher
goal: a faster detector for near-real-time live studies (teacher dominates the ~1 fps end-to-end rate)

gates_pre_stated.G1_val_dice: >=0.95 on the frozen held-out 200 Kvasir images (teacher 0.959)
gates_pre_stated.G2_control_fire: <=7.5% on the two held-out calibration control clips (teacher 5.0%)
gates_pre_stated.G3_speed: >=2.5x teacher ONNX CPU latency (workstation proxy for the phone)

runs.recipe: teacher's fine-tune recipe (8 ep, lr 2e-5) on ImageNet init
runs.verdict: undertrained: teacher started polyp-pretrained, student did not; Dice still climbing at stop

runs.recipe: training regime: 30 ep, lr 1e-4 cosine, distill weight 0.5
runs.verdict: converged but data-limited: train loss 0.09 (fits the 800 images) while val stalls

runs.recipe: run 2 + strong augmentation (flip/rotate/scale/color) + 1000 unlabeled C3VD colon frames labeled by the teacher on the fly (distill-only loss); HyperKvasir frames deliberately excluded because the untouched test clips live there
runs.verdict: augmentation + in-domain unlabeled distillation buys +0.008; student saturates ~0.89

speed.protocol: median of 50 CPU runs, quiet machine, ONE ort session alive at a time; replicated (2.29x, 2.28x)

invalid_readings.cause: benchmarked while the training job was decoding video on all cores
busy-machine screen inflated the teacher more than the student
two live ort sessions: each holds a spin-waiting full-core thread pool and they fight; timings inflate 2-5x

verdict: REJECTED by pre-stated gates; the B4 teacher stays deployed. A ~0.89-Dice, 2.3x-faster student exists (models/polyp_student/) if a future use case accepts that tradeoff; it is not Argus.
method_note: three timing traps in one experiment produced 0.80x, 2.82x and 2.29x for the same two models; only the controlled single-session quiet-machine number is reportable. Same lesson as the NNAPI reversal: a speed claim is only as good as its measurement conditions.
artifacts: speqslam/train_student.py (full run history in header), speqslam/bench_student.py, models/polyp_student/{run1_teacher_recipe,run2_no_aug,metrics.csv,student_best.pth,student.onnx}
